items.title: Renault begins exports of all-new Duster from India, ships first batch to South Africa
items.summary: The firm aims to achieve annual exports worth €2 billion from India by 2030.

items.title: 2026 Tata Tigor Facelift Design Patented – New Front, Connected LED, 360 Cam Likely
items.summary: Ahead of its official debut, Tata Motors has patented the design of the 2026 Tigor Facelift, giving a clear look at the exterior changes planned for the compact sedan. items.title: Hyundai launches nationwide Smart Care Clinic across 1,600 service centres
items.summary: The initiative will be conducted across more than 1,600 Hyundai service centres in the country from June 24 to July 8, 2026.

items.title: Force Motors rolls out 200,000th Mercedes-Benz engine in India
items.summary: The 200,000th unit, a six-cylinder M256 engine, has been fitted into a Mercedes-Benz GLS 450, the company said.

items.title: BMW’s MINI launches locally made Countryman C in India at ₹47.5 lakh
items.summary: The petrol-powered sport utility vehicle is being manufactured at the company’s Chennai plant, marking the latest addition to MINI’s India lineup under local production.
